verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated sandbox/test account with test cards, disputes, fraud, payouts testing, and a separate sandbox MCP endpoint (checkout.mcp.sbox.cko.tech) distinct from production, explicitly enabling AI-native testing without touching live data. This is corroborated by both docs and a live probe confirming the production MCP endpoint requires OAuth, implying environment separation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the sandbox MCP endpoint behaves identically to production and full parity documentation between sandbox and prod feature sets.
